_doc: Detachment rules the engine applies by itself, keyed by detachment name (Wahapedia spelling).
auto: full = everything in the rule is automatic; partial = the main effect is automatic, the rest is in 'manual'.
units: every entry must match the unit; 'A|B' = either; 'name:X' = datasheet name X; plain words are keywords.
if: all must hold. charged, stationary, within12, targetMV, targetNotMV, targetCharMV, targetOath, belowStarting, belowHalf,
battleShocked, notBattleShocked, inTerrain, onObjective, targetOnObjective, objectiveEitherWay, riled, setUpThisTurn,
offence: hit, wound, ap, strength, attacks (numbers to add), reroll: hits1 | hits | wounds1 | wounds, abilities: weapon abilities.
defend: woundMinusIfStronger, coverUnless12, inv + rangedOnly, enemyStrengthMinus (when this army's unit is attacked).
rolls: rerollAdvance, rerollCharge, advanceSix, advanceBonus, chargeBonus, move (+M), oc (+OC), shockedOc (OC while battle-shocked).
choice: when = command (start of your Command phase, lasts until your next one) | round (each battle round) | battle (start of the battle, lasts all game);
uses = eachOnce (each option once per battle) | limit (at most 'limit' activations, no repeats) | free; pick = options chosen at once.

Cursed Legion.desc: Cold Fervour: Flayed Ones and Destroyer Cult units gain +1 to Hit when targeting enemy units below Starting Strength.

Cold Fervour.desc: +1 to Hit against below Starting Strength enemy units for Flayed Ones and Destroyer Cult.

Pantheon of Woe.desc: Cosmic Distortion: C’tan Shard models have a 4+ Feel No Pain against mortal wounds and their aura ranges are increased by 3".

Cosmic Distortion.desc: C’tan Shards gain 4+ Feel No Pain against mortal wounds and +3" aura ranges.

Hand of the Dynasty.desc: Hypermotility Protocols: Immortals and Necron Warriors ranged weapons have [ASSAULT] and can advance without failing action eligibility.

Hypermotility Protocols.desc: Immortals and Necron Warriors ranged attacks have [ASSAULT]; Advance moves do not prevent starting actions.

Skyshroud Spearhead.desc: Transdimensional Deployment: Tomb Blades units have Deep Strike and +1 to Hit on ranged attacks during the turn they arrive from Reserves.

Transdimensional Deployment.desc: Tomb Blades gain Deep Strike and +1 to Hit on ingress/reserves arrival turn.

The Phaeron's Armoury.desc: Empowered Engines: Necrons Titanic Fly units have +6" Move.

Empowered Engines.desc: Necrons Titanic Fly units have +6" Move.

Teleport Assault.desc: At the end of your opponent’s turn, select up to N Grey Knights units (Incursion: 2, Strike Force: 3, Onslaught: 4) and place them into Strategic Reserves. In your next Movement phase, they can arrive via Deep Strike.

Teleport Strike Force.desc: Teleport Shunt: Each time a Grey Knights unit with Teleport Assault Advances, until the end of the phase it can Fly and is eligible to shoot and charge.

Teleport Shunt.desc: Advance moves grant Fly and do not prevent shooting or charging.

Warpbane Task Force.desc: Hallowed Ground: While a friendly Grey Knights unit is within range of an objective marker you control or wholly within your territory, improve its invulnerable save by 1 (to a max of 4+) and add 1 to Hit rolls.

Hallowed Ground.desc: +1 to Hit rolls and improved invulnerable save while on controlled objectives or in own territory.

Brotherhood Strike.desc: Fury of Titan: Brotherhood Terminator and Paladin Squad models re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Fury of Titan.desc: Brotherhood Terminator and Paladin models re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

Hallowed Conclave.desc: Duty Before All: Grey Knights Character models gain +1 Attack to melee weapons and +1 to Objective Control.

Duty Before All.desc: Character models gain +1 Melee Attack and +1 OC.

Banishers.desc: Channelled Force: Melee weapons equipped by Grey Knights models gain [LETHAL HITS]. In addition, against Daemon and Psyker units, add 1 to the Damage characteristic.

Channelled Force.desc: Melee weapons have [LETHAL HITS]; +1 Damage against Daemon and Psyker targets.

Sanctic Spearhead.desc: Mailed Fist: Nemesis Dreadknight models add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee attacks during the turn they charged.

Mailed Fist.desc: +1 Damage to Nemesis Dreadknight melee attacks on the turn they charged.

Augurium Task Force.desc: Prescient Redeployment: After determining who has the first turn, you can redeploy up to 3 Grey Knights units.

Prescient Redeployment.desc: Redeploy up to 3 units after first turn is determined.

Argent Assault.desc: Dauntless Champions: When a Paladin Squad is selected to fight, if Strength is lower than target Toughness, add 1 to Wound rolls.

Dauntless Champions.desc: Paladin Squad models get +1 to Wound when Strength < target Toughness.

Fires of Purgation.desc: Searing Soulflame: When a Purgation Squad pins an enemy unit, that enemy makes a Battle-shock test with a -1 modifier.

Immaterial Interdiction.desc: Echojump: After shooting, an Interceptor Squad can make a D6" surge move.

Echojump.desc: Interceptor Squads can make a D6" surge move after shooting.
